items.title: 15 Outdoor Art Shows to See in NYC This Summer
items.summary: Slide through a teddy bear, get weird with a neural network’s hallucinations, play ping-pong on an artist-made table, and so much more.

items.title: Long-Contested Guggenheim Abu Dhabi Gets Opening Date

items.title: How a Former Military Settlement in Taipei Became an Artist Residency
items.summary: Treasure Hill served as a Japanese ammunition depot and Kuomintang squatter settlement prior to its reopening as an artist village in 2010.

items.title: V&A Storehouse Workers Vote to Strike Over “Amazon-Style” Conditions
